topic: A5: Client surfaces the pivot touches (categories, fabricated numbers, share flow, feedback card) at origin/main 95cf6f86
summary:
Read-only at C:/Users/SynAckITPC/Documents/AI/sc-s80-b2 (95cf6f86). No S80 digest covered fabricated numbers or share. Category and feedback context from category_metrics_claims, category_walk_and_q5q9 and feedback_and_allowlists still holds. The deltas are below.

CATEGORIES. The chip list is one array, CategorySelector.tsx:38-50 (9 entries, 'other' included). The chip is only a hint. HomeScreen sends selected_category only when a chip is tapped (HomeScreen.tsx:126, 414, 567; api.ts:686, 832, 972). The backend's name detection overrides the chip (scs:483-486). So hiding six chips does NOT limit what users can compare: typing "iPhone vs Galaxy" still runs electronics. A real fragrance-only rule needs a dark backend gate.
Other client surfaces still advertise hidden categories:
- QuickCategories tiles electronics/skincare/supplements/makeup (HomeEditorialSections.tsx:260-265).
- SMART_PICK_CATEGORY_KEYS (:49-58).
- Placeholders "e.g. iPhone 15 / Galaxy S24" and the onboarding quote "Galaxy or iPhone?" (en.json:729-730, 537).
No coming-soon key or event exists. A tap event must be added to VALID_EVENT_TYPES before any client fires it. Two tests pin nine chips: CategorySelector.test.tsx:12-39 and the s3 integration mock.

FABRICATED NUMBERS. S69 and S74 already removed most of them. What remains:
- CohortBadge renders "{{count}}+ shoppers in {gov} leaned the same way". The count is real: cohort_priors n, 5-30, from 388 survey responses. But the claim is false: n is the survey cohort size, not shoppers who picked this winner. It shows on Results and Referral.
- The InviteeQuiz match % falls back to an invented 78.
- LoadingRings still defaults counterTarget=2074 with showCounter=true. Every current caller turns it off, but the snapshot pins it.
- The share text claims "ends the debate in 30 seconds".
- The savings banner reads "~N BHD shopped smarter" (loser price minus winner price).
- Seven orphan i18n keys still hold 73% or {{count}} claims.

SHARE. Two paths:
1. Fresh compares have no comparison_id, so they fall back to a hardcoded ENGLISH Share.share text with no link (ResultsScreen.tsx:532-546).
2. With an id, ShareBottomSheet offers WhatsApp/Copy/X/Telegram/Snapchat. All use one generic catalog message. Snapchat and Copy both just open the OS sheet.
Problems:
- app.json declares no LSApplicationQueriesSchemes, so WhatsApp's whatsapp:// check likely fails on iOS and falls back to the OS sheet.
- No Instagram target; adding one needs a migration-014 CHECK change plus the referral_routes Literal.
- The /c/ hand-off page has no OG tags, is noindex, and APP_STORE_URL is empty.
- The legacy /share route points at the raw Railway host, and its client function is imported but never called.

FEEDBACK. FeedbackCard is three positive-only chips that always send useful:true. Nothing reads mattered_most. The B1 correctness fields and C6 reason chips are accepted by the server but no client sends them. The only useful:false rows are ContactUs bug reports, so behavior_service winner_agreement and vw_cohort_feedback_lift measure nothing.

findings.claim: The Home chip list is a single 9-entry array including 'other', rendered by HomeScreen only when canCompare. selected_category starts null and is sent only after a chip tap, on all three compare sites. Hiding six chips is a one-array client edit.

Hiding chips client-side does not restrict categories. The backend lets name detection override the chip on the explicit and vision paths, the camera route takes no chip, and all 9 categories keep schemas and dimensions. A typed electronics pair still runs as electronics, so 'only fragrances work' needs a dark backend gate (e.g. a category allowlist flag that returns an abstain or coming-soon status).
evidence: S80 digest r0/category_walk_and_q5q9.json - image_routes has no category param (still valid)

findings.claim: Other Home and onboarding surfaces still advertise categories that will be hidden: QuickCategories tiles (electronics, skincare, supplements, makeup), SmartPick category pill keys, the compare-box placeholders 'e.g. iPhone 15 / Galaxy S24', and the onboarding quote 'Galaxy or iPhone?'.

Tests that pin the 9-chip list: CategorySelector.test.tsx asserts all 9 testIDs and exactly 9 icons. The HomeScreen s3 integration test uses its own 9-key mock and presses electronics, then fragrances. No snapshot contains category chips.
evidence: grep of all __tests__ .snap files - no category-chip or home.categories hits

findings.claim: There is no 'coming soon' key and no category-tap event today. A new event_type must be added to VALID_EVENT_TYPES before any client fires it: an unknown type gets a 422 that drops the whole batch, and tests/test_events_allowlist_superset.py greps literal trackEvent args in the client. /events accepts anonymous calls, is limited to 60/min, and writes user_events fire-and-forget.
evidence: C:/Users/SynAckITPC/Documents/AI/sc-s80-b2/SmartCompareApp/__tests__/clientTruth/copyTruth.s74.test.ts:73-83 - an S74 pin already removed one 'coming soon' string

findings.claim: CohortBadge shows a real number under a false claim. peer_count is cohort_match.n from cohort_priors.json: the survey sample size of the user's age/gender/governorate/language cell, n 5-30, 388 responses in total. The copy says '{{count}}+ shoppers in {{governorate}} leaned the same way', which implies they picked this winner. It renders on Results when ENABLE_COHORT_PERSONALIZATION is on (ON in prod per CLAUDE.md:246) and a match exists.

The ReferralLanding CohortBadge never renders: the backend always sends cohort_match None. Removing it is dead-code cleanup only. Pins: CohortBadge.test.tsx (6 tests) and about 17 test files that mention cohort_summary/cohortPeerCount.

LoadingRings still defaults counterTarget=2074 and showCounter=true. All three live callers turn it off: Home passes showCounter={false}, Results passes showCounter={false}, and Step14 shows it only with a real count, which OnboardingFlow never passes. So 2,074 is latent, not visible. The LoadingRings snapshot and LoadingRings.test.tsx pin 2074 and its formatting.

The InviteeQuiz match % uses CounterTicker with an invented fallback of 78 when scoring is missing, and labels a product score as 'match for you'. CounterTicker.tsx line 4 is only a doc comment about '388 GCC shoppers'; the component has no hardcoded number.

Seven orphan i18n keys carry fabricated or survey-count claims and have no render site: loading.tip.peer_prioritize (73%), results.tips.cohort_priority (73%), results.tips.cohort_match, cohort.trainedBy ({{count}} survey), onboarding.s14.cohort_footer, profile.styleProfile.basedOn, profile.styleProfile.peersInGovernorate. Step13's defaultValue still has a 73% string but is unreachable because the key exists. honestLoaders pins that peer_prioritize never rotates in.
evidence: grep src/**/*.ts(x): no t() reader for these keys

findings.claim: Survey copy still rendered: s12 title and bullets ('Based on answers from real GCC shoppers'), s14 tip_2 and loading.cohort.caption (shown only with a real count, so never), and s15.subtitle 'Informed by a survey of GCC shoppers'. None has a digit; copyTruth CT-C3 pins s12.title digit-free. The survey is real (388 responses), so this is a wording choice, not a fabrication.

Two numeric marketing claims remain. (1) The share message 'MYEZ ends the debate in 30 seconds': S80 measured cold text compares at 30.2-30.8 s and scans at about 40 s. (2) The SavingsBanner '~N BHD shopped smarter' sums max(loser price - winner price, 0) across 3 or more compares; that is a price gap, not money saved, and prices can be estimates.

Share path 1: fresh compares have no comparison_id, so they fall back to Share.share with a hardcoded ENGLISH body ('Comparing A vs B / Winner: X / recommendation'). It carries no link, no app name and no Arabic. Since comparison_id echo is off, this is the usual path.
evidence: S80 digest contract_freeze.json - ENABLE_COMPARISON_ID_ECHO changes Share behaviour (text_routes.py:73-79)

findings.claim: Share path 2, ShareBottomSheet (only with a saved id): five targets, WhatsApp/Copy/X/Telegram/Snapchat. Every target gets the same generic catalog message, which has no product names. Snapchat and Copy both open the OS share sheet. WhatsApp uses whatsapp://send, but app.json declares no LSApplicationQueriesSchemes, so on iOS canOpenURL likely returns false and it falls back to the OS sheet. Telegram passes the link twice (in url= and inside the text). There is no Instagram target. The icons are generic lucide glyphs.
evidence: C:/Users/SynAckITPC/Documents/AI/sc-s80-b2/SmartCompareApp/app.json:20-24 - ios block, no LSApplicationQueriesSchemes (repo-wide grep 0 hits)

findings.claim: The share link has the form https://getmyez.com/c/<token>?ref=CODE. nginx serves the static open.html for /c/, /r/ and /q/. The page has no og:title/og:image (so link previews are generic), is robots noindex, and has APP_STORE_URL='' so the store button stays hidden. The legacy POST /api/v1/share returns a raw Railway URL; shareComparison is imported in ResultsScreen but never called.

Adding a share target such as Instagram needs a DB change, not just client work: share_target is a Pydantic Literal plus a CHECK in migration 014. The Deep Review credit is still granted server-side, but S74 removed every client claim about it and shareTruth CT-S1/S2/S3 pin that.

FeedbackCard is three positive-only chips (Accurate/Detailed/Fast) under 'Was this helpful?'. Every tap sends useful:true with mattered_most:[chip], and comparison_id is null on fresh compares. There is no negative path and no free text, and it never sends winner_correct/price_correct/specs_correct or the C6 reason chips the server now accepts.

What the feedback collects in practice is close to nothing usable. No backend code reads mattered_most or the correctness columns. behavior_service.winner_agreement counts useful true/false, but the only false rows come from ContactUs bug reports (useful = category !== 'bug'), so agreement is near 100% by design. vw_cohort_feedback_lift.useful_pct has the same flaw. analytics_service.py reads only search_logs and products.
evidence: grep app/**/*.py mattered_most|winner_correct - only feedback_routes/feedback_service writers

findings.claim: No migration contains CREATE TABLE for comparison_feedback; the base table was created out of band (7 columns per the 2026-06-08 inventory). Migration 027 adds the three correctness columns with CHECK (correct|wrong|unsure). Any new question columns, such as a correct-price value or a wrong-product note, need a new additive migration.

category_switched still has no client render site; only types.ts declares it. If the backend reroutes a hidden category to fragrances or abstains, the user will not see why unless new client copy ships.

recommendations: Categories (client, merge now, ship by OTA after approval): replace CATEGORIES with fragrances (active) plus skincare and makeup as disabled 'coming soon' chips, and drop 'other'. Also cut QUICK_CATS and the SmartPick keys down to those three. Update CategorySelector.test.tsx:12-39 and the s3 integration mock. Reason: one array plus two tests, all client-side.

Before any client fires it, add one event type such as 'category_coming_soon_tap' with event_data {category} to VALID_EVENT_TYPES. This is an unflagged, additive widening following the S80 C7 precedent. Reason: otherwise the whole event batch 422s and the superset test fails.

Enforce fragrance-only on the backend behind a dark flag (e.g. ENABLE_CATEGORY_ALLOWLIST, read per call, OFF byte-identical). When the resolved category_used is not allowed, return an honest 'not supported yet' status. Reason: the chip is only a hint and name detection runs every category today.
Replace the electronics example copy (home.compare.box_a_text/box_b_text, onboarding.s1.quote_1) with fragrance examples in EN and AR. Reason: it contradicts the three-category app.

Remove CohortBadge from ResultsContent and ReferralLanding, delete the seven orphan keys, delete the LoadingRings 2074 default and the InviteeQuiz 78 fallback (hide the % when no score), and rewrite the '30 seconds' and 'shopped smarter' copy. Update the LoadingRings snapshot, CohortBadge.test and the honestCounts/honestLoaders pins. Reason: these are every remaining invented or misattributed number.

Before shipping a 'coming soon' chip, check Apple Guideline 2.1/2.3 on placeholder features against official docs. Reason: an S74 pin already removed one 'coming soon' string, and build 3 is still in App Review.

Share text-only path: use a localized, product-aware catalog key (referrals.share.message already exists, unused) and append the getmyez.com link. Reason: Arabic users currently share hardcoded English with no link.

Per-platform share: WhatsApp needs LSApplicationQueriesSchemes (a native change, so 1.0.1) or should go through the OS sheet. Stop passing the link twice on Telegram. Instagram Stories needs a native SDK plus a migration-014 CHECK and Literal widening. Reason: the platform deep links are partly fake today.

Landing: add og:title/og:description/og:image to open.html, ideally per token from the backend, and fill APP_STORE_URL once approved. Reason: shared links preview as a generic 'Open in MYEZ' page with no store button.

Feedback: replace the three positive chips with a two-step card. Step 1: 'Did we pick the right winner?' yes/no/unsure, written to winner_correct. Step 2 on a 'no': the C6 reason chips plus an optional free-text 'correct price/spec' field. Use only fields the backend already accepts so it stays additive. Reason: today every row says useful:true and nothing reads mattered_most.

Stop ContactUs writing to comparison_feedback.useful (route it to its own table or a tagged column), or exclude rows with a null comparison_id from winner_agreement. Reason: bug reports are the only useful:false rows and they distort the behaviour profile.

Build the critique loop's offline reader (the pivot's point 4) on winner_correct, the reason chips and comparison_id. Requires the comparison_id echo (ENABLE_COMPARISON_ID_ECHO) so feedback rows can be joined. Reason: without the id, feedback cannot be tied to a comparison.
open_questions: Is ENABLE_COMPARISON_ID_ECHO ON in prod? If not, almost every share uses the English text-only path and every feedback row has comparison_id null (not verified; Railway not read).
Should skincare and makeup 'coming soon' chips be tappable (to record the tap) and still let the user compare, or be fully disabled? The backend fully supports both categories today.
Does the owner keep the 388-response survey copy (onboarding s12/s15 'Informed by a survey of GCC shoppers'), which is true, or remove all cohort and survey language?
Does iOS canOpenURL('whatsapp://') really return false on build 3 with no LSApplicationQueriesSchemes? Inferred from Apple's rule, not device-tested.
Should the hidden-category backend response be an abstain, a 'not supported yet' status, or a redirect to fragrances? This affects the share-refusal and history paths (B2 rulings are still owed).
